# Incremental Reconcile

The incremental reconcile feature allows processing of merged pull requests and direct commits made after a specified point in time. This selective processing ensures that only changes relevant to the most recent commits are compiled, thereby optimizing efficiency and resource usage.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.reconcile`
